content: The National Diabetes Information Clearinghouse (NDIC) is an information dissemination service that operates under the National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases (NIDDK), which is part of the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services. Established in 1978, the NDIC provides comprehensive information about diabetes to individuals living with the condition, their families, healthcare professionals, and the general public. The NDIC responds to inquiries, develops and distributes educational publications, and collaborates closely with professional organizations, patient advocacy groups, and government agencies to coordinate resources related to diabetes. The publications produced by the NDIC undergo rigorous review processes, which include evaluations by NIDDK scientists as well as external experts, to ensure accuracy and reliability.
